mentions.name: Novalede
mentions.description: This app is an MCP-connected newspaper that turns newsletters and email into articles with the key point front and centre, so the gist of whether a message matters is immediately clear. It also picks Hacker News articles of interest and summarizes what the comments say, removing sensationalism from reactions.
mentions.problem: The author got tired of unread newsletters piling up in the inbox, emails building up where the important part has to be hunted for, and not being able to quickly tell whether an email affects them.
mentions.source_excerpt:
1. Novalede - https://www.novalede.com

I got tired of having newsletters in my inbox that I never read, and emails building up where you have to hunt for the important part, and not really being able to get the gist of whether the email affects me or not.

So I build an MCP connected newspaper. Ask your agent to publish them as articles where the lead is front and centre, and I can read it first thing in the morning.
mentions.author: martin-adams
